description: Installation of solar PV panels to front elevation roof slope.
decision_conditions: Reasons(s): Overall, the proposed development is considered to be of an unacceptable design and scale, and would harm the character and appearance of the host building and the surrounding area. The proposed materials are not compatible with the local vernacular and are considered to detract from the visual amenity of the street scene. The impact of the proposed design of the solar panels on the character and appearance of the host building and local context would be unacceptable.Policy: Development proposals are expected to demonstrate a high standard of design that  respond positively to the local context and, where possible, enhance the character of the area through a carefully considered layout, scale, and design that reflects the existing and emerging street hierarchy and built form. Furthermore, developments should respect and reinforce the character and appearance of both the original building and the wider surrounding area in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021, Policies CS8 and DM10 of the Council's Core Strategy, and the guidance set out in the Council's Residential Design SPD (2012) and Conservation Area General Guidance (2023).

Reason(s): The proposed materials, the scale of the development, and the location of the panels would have an adverse impact upon the existing character and appearance of the host building. The location of the proposed development would be visible from within the Liverpool Road Conservation Area, a designated heritage asset, and thus would harm the character and appearance of a heritage asset. The proposal is considered to constitute 'less than substantial harm' to the Conservation Area and it is not considered that there are any public benefits that would outweigh this harm.  As such, the proposed development would not preserve or enhance the character of the Liverpool Road Conservation Area and would therefore be unacceptable.Policy: The proposed development would be in violation of the statutory / special duties with regards to heritage assets in terms of not resulting in less than substantial harm to the significance of the Liverpool Road Conservation Area. It would also be in violation of national planning policy and guidance, London Plan Policies, and Policies CS8, DM10 and DM12 of the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames Core Strategy 2012.
